props.gloss_en: R' Yannai: tefillin require a clean body, like Elisha Man of Wings
what is it? Abaye: that he not break wind in them
Rava: that he not sleep in them
once wicked Rome decreed persecution against Israel: whoever dons tefillin, they will pierce his brain
and Elisha would don them and go out to the market
[the official] said to him: what is this in your hand? He said to him: dove's wings

an official saw him; he ran from him and [the official] ran after him; when he reached him he took them off his head and held them in his hand ... he opened his hand and they were found to be dove's wings
why is he called Man of Wings? ... therefore they call him Elisha Man of Wings
and why dove's wings rather than other birds'? because the community of Israel is likened to a dove
as it is said: 'the wings of a dove covered with silver ...' (Ps 68:14)
as a dove -- its wings protect it, so Israel -- the mitzvot protect them
